_meta.description: Bootstrap seed for the judge-reliability harness (issue #152).
_meta.bootstrap_notice: This is a SHAPE-ONLY bootstrap. Every 'label' equals the row's 'recorded_verdict' by construction, so calibration metrics on this seed alone are trivially perfect and prove only that the harness code path executes end-to-end. Real calibration requires augmenting this seed with human-labeled rows where 'label' is set INDEPENDENTLY of the verifier's own output, drawn from operator-reviewed outcomes on resolved investigations (e.g., approved -> label matches verifier verdict; rejected -> label opposes it). Do NOT add rows whose 'label' is inferred from the verifier's own output.
sources: tests/test_vr_masvs_verdict_mapper.py:68-71 (real refuted+confirmed fixtures the masvs mapper consumes)
_meta.augmentation_protocol: For each resolved investigation with a canonical outcome carrying payload['verifier_report'], record: (a) the extractor claim text passed to the verifier (VR reads payload['answer']; malware routes through render_outcome_claim_text), (b) the composed verdict_input text (_render_verdict_input over preconditions+probe_results) as 'evidence', (c) label from the operator's dispatch decision on that outcome (approved+dispatched_to_finding -> matches verifier verdict; rejected_by_operator -> opposite of verifier verdict). Cite the investigation_id + canonical_outcome_id in 'provenance'.

rows.claim: The parser at src/foo.cc:120 dereferences an unchecked pointer from user-controlled input, producing a memory-safety vulnerability reachable from the network entry point.
rows.label: refuted
rows.provenance: Bootstrap shape row modelled on tests/platform/agents/test_synthesis_runner_verifier_annotation.py:263-268 (recorded verifier_report={verdict:'refuted', confidence:0.15, summary:'Probe with malformed input did not reproduce; the guard at src/foo.cc:118 short-circuits before the cast.'}); label equals recorded_verdict per the shape-only bootstrap protocol.

rows.claim: The finding at the affected component is a confirmed vulnerability meeting the MASVS control criteria at the 0.82 confidence band.
rows.evidence:
# Preconditions and probe results

## P1: The affected component is reachable from an external entry point
refutation_signature: If no external caller reaches the sink, the finding is refuted.
if_refuted_then: The finding is refuted.
probe: callers_of args={'function': 'affected_sink'}
probe_result:
(3 entries)
handle_external_request  src/net/http.c:412
dispatch_message  src/net/router.c:88
run_worker  src/worker.c:132

Now produce the JSON verdict per the system prompt.
rows.label: confirmed
rows.provenance: Bootstrap shape row modelled on tests/test_vr_masvs_verdict_mapper.py:65-71 (recorded verifier_report={verdict:'confirmed', confidence:0.82} at the FINDING floor); label equals recorded_verdict per the shape-only bootstrap protocol.

Now produce the JSON verdict per the system prompt.

rows.claim: The direct finding at the affected component is confirmed at the operator-review high-priority band.
rows.evidence:
# Preconditions and probe results

## P1: Every load-bearing precondition returned true with no unknown remaining
refutation_signature: If any load-bearing precondition returned unknown, downgrade the confidence band.
if_refuted_then: The finding is inconclusive.
probe: taint_paths_to args={'sink': 'affected_sink'}
probe_result:
(1 entries)
source=http_request_body  sink=memcpy  hops=3  src/net/http.c:412 -> src/net/router.c:88 -> src/net/dispatch.c:132

Now produce the JSON verdict per the system prompt.
rows.label: confirmed
rows.provenance: Bootstrap shape row modelled on tests/test_vr_masvs_verdict_mapper.py:539-541 (recorded verifier_report={verdict:'confirmed', confidence:0.9} on a direct_finding with concrete affected_components); label equals recorded_verdict per the shape-only bootstrap protocol.
